name: About Modal UI
description: UI interaction spec for the version/credits dialog.

dom.overlay: .modal-overlay (display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6); z-index:5000)
dom.modal: .about-modal (width:420px; padding:24px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface); box-shadow:var(--shadow))
structure: button.btn-ghost.about-close-btn (padding:6px 14px; background:transparent; border:1px dashed var(--border); cursor:pointer; font-size:11px)

interactions.name: open
interactions.action: Set overlay display:flex, store onClose callback

interactions.name: close_button
interactions.action: Hide overlay (display:none), fire onClose callback, clear onClose reference

interactions.name: overlay_dismiss
interactions.action: Same as close button — hide and fire callback

interactions.name: design_link
interactions.action: IPC shell:openExternal with encoded URL containing Noir palette + Art Nouveau + Floating + Space Mono params

states.visible: Overlay display:flex, onClose callback stored and active

content.style_link: UseDesign.md — external URL with design params (mash=1, p=noir, c=Art+Nouveau, s=Floating, etc.)
